get.description: Retrieves a list of active home banners for the landing page. This endpoint is public and does not require authentication. Only banners that are currently active (based on the current date and the banner's start_date and end_date) will be returned.

post.description: Sends an email containing a reset link to the address, if an active account uses it. The response is always the same whether or not the email is registered, so this endpoint cannot be used to discover which addresses have accounts. The link points to {FRONTEND_URL}/reset-password?token=... and the token is valid for 60 minutes. Requesting a new link invalidates any previous one. Limited to 3 requests per account per hour.

200.description: Request accepted. This is returned even when the email is not registered.

message.example: If the email is registered, a password reset link has been sent

429.description: Too many password reset requests for this account, try again later

post.description: Sets a new password using the token from the reset email. The token can only be used once and expires 60 minutes after it was issued. A confirmation email is sent afterwards.

400.description: The token is invalid, already used, or expired; or the new password fails validation

post.description: Changes the password of the currently authenticated user. The current password must be supplied and the new one must differ from it. Any pending password reset links for the account are invalidated, and a confirmation email is sent. Existing access tokens stay valid until they expire.

400.description: The current password is wrong, or the new password fails validation

get.description: Lists the events that have at least one gallery, along with how many galleries each one has. Galleries are grouped by event rather than by a separate category table, so this is the list the frontend uses to build the gallery filter. Feed the event_id from here into GET /galleries?event_id=...

200.description: A JSON array of gallery categories

get.description: Downloads the spreadsheet template for the dataset. The .xlsx version has a Data sheet with the headers and two example rows, plus a Petunjuk sheet explaining every column. Relations are filled in using values a human already knows, such as a member NIM or a division slug, and the server resolves them during import. Identical files are also committed under docs/templates/.

parameters.name: format
parameters.description: File format. The csv version carries the headers and examples but no explanation sheet.

404.description: No template exists for this entity

post.description: Validates an uploaded file without saving anything. Every row is checked the same way the real import checks it, including duplicate detection against existing data and against other rows in the same file, so the report shows exactly which rows would fail. Run this before the real import. Because nothing is written, the status is always 200 as long as the file could be read.

file.description: An .xlsx or .csv file following the downloaded template. Maximum 5 MB and 500 data rows.

200.description: The file was read and every row validated. Nothing was saved.

message.example: Import preview completed, no data was saved

400.description: The file is missing, has an unsupported type, lacks a required column, or contains no data rows

404.description: Import is not available for this entity

413.description: The file is larger than 5 MB

post.description: Validates and saves the rows of an uploaded file. Rows are processed one by one and a failing row does not stop the others, so a partially valid file returns 207 with the successful rows already saved. Each entry in the report names the row number in the file. Use the preview endpoint first if you want to check the file without saving.

file.description: An .xlsx or .csv file following the downloaded template. Maximum 5 MB and 500 data rows.

207.description: Some rows were imported and some failed. The successful rows are already saved; fix the reported rows and upload them again.

400.description: Every row failed, or the file is missing, unsupported, or malformed

404.description: Import is not available for this entity

413.description: The file is larger than 5 MB

row.description: Import only: the row number in the uploaded file, counting the header as row 1.

error.description: Present only when the item failed.
